column1: # Full or half views of a packed video frame (stereo_policy_video_views). Read by the C test, the Qt test and the Java
# mirror in Universal Media Server, so that all three decide alike.
# Columns, tab separated: name, layout (1 side by side, 2 top and bottom, 4 rows, 8 frame sequential), coded width,
# coded height, sample aspect ratio numerator and denominator, Matroska plane width and height (0 when the track has
# none), H.265 upsampled_aspect_ratio_flag (-1 when not at hand), expected (1 full, 0 half, -1 error), decided by
# (0 layout, 1 mark, 2 shape).
full side by side, nothing marked
half side by side, nothing marked
two 4:3 views side by side, nothing marked
one 21:9 view in a half pair, nothing marked
full side by side, one plane shown (DisplayWidth 1920)
full side by side, one plane shown, square samples
full side by side, the sample ratio halves it and no plane (the shape cannot tell)
half side by side, plane is the default
half side by side, plane has the shape of the frame
full side by side, plane is the default (3840x1080)
side by side with doubled sample ratio, nothing marked
H.265 flag 1, up-converted samples: half
H.265 flag 0, samples as stored: full
the plane comes before the flag
full top and bottom, one plane shown
half top and bottom, plane is the default
half top and bottom, plane has the shape of the frame
full top and bottom, nothing marked
rows are always half
frame sequential is whole frames
no packing
no size
